title: Enhancing RAG-based Medical VQA with Gated Multimodal Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.23588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) have shown strong performance in Medical Visual Question Answering (MVQA), yet they may still produce factually inconsistent responses. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can mitigate this issue by incorporating external clinical evidence; however, retrieval is often guided by a single modality, potentially overlooking the joint semantics of medical images and clinical questions. We introduce a multimodal RAG framework that learns a joint query representation through a Gated Multimodal Unit, enabling evidence retrieval to leverage information from both modalities while keeping the underlying Med-LVLM frozen. We evaluate the proposed approach on benchmark datasets. Results show that the multimodal query representation consistently outperforms a reference Med-LVLM and remains competitive with state-of-the-art methods. translated_title: 基于门控多模态表示增强RAG医学视觉问答
translated_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（Med-LVLMs）在医学视觉问答（MVQA）任务中已展现出强大性能，但仍可能产生与事实不一致的回答。检索增强生成（RAG）可以通过引入外部临床证据来缓解这一问题；然而，检索通常仅由单一模态引导，可能忽略了医学图像与临床问题的联合语义。我们提出了一种多模态RAG框架，通过门控多模态单元学习联合查询表示，使证据检索能够同时利用两种模态的信息，同时保持底层Med-LVLM模型冻结不变。我们在基准数据集上评估了所提出的方法。结果表明，多模态查询表示始终优于参考Med-LVLM，并与最先进的方法保持竞争力。我们的发现展示了多模态查询表示在提升医学视觉问答可靠性方面的潜力。
tldr: 提出了一种通过门控多模态单元学习联合查询表示的多模态RAG框架，使医学视觉问答中的证据检索能同时融合医学图像与临床问题两种模态的信息，且无需微调底层医学视觉-语言模型。
en_tdlr: A multimodal RAG framework that learns joint query representations via a Gated Multimodal Unit, enabling evidence retrieval to leverage both medical image and clinical question modalities while keeping the underlying Med-LVLM frozen.
